# Third-party browser assets

- Decap CMS 3.17.1, MIT, from https://registry.npmjs.org/decap-cms/-/decap-cms-3.17.1.tgz. Distribution notices are included in `decap-cms.js.LICENSE.txt`. Source: https://github.com/decaporg/decap-cms.
- Jodit 4.18.3, MIT, from https://registry.npmjs.org/jodit/-/jodit-4.18.3.tgz. License is included in `JODIT-LICENSE.txt`. Source: https://github.com/xdan/jodit.

The Firebase Authentication bridge imports Firebase JS SDK 12.4.0 from Google's official gstatic CDN. No OAuth client secret is shipped in any browser asset or repository file.

- DOMPurify 3.4.17, Apache-2.0 OR MPL-2.0, from https://registry.npmjs.org/dompurify/-/dompurify-3.4.17.tgz. License included in `DOMPURIFY-LICENSE.txt`; source https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify. Used to sanitize article HTML before it enters the visual editor.
